text: 2026年7月28日，财政部部长蓝佛安在北京会见刚果共和国副总理布亚。双方主要就两国财金领域合作和宏观经济形势等问题交换意见。进出口银行董事长陈怀宇，刚果共和国财政、预算和国库部部长约卡、驻华大使马米纳等参加会见。（财政部网站）
text_en: On July 28, 2026, Finance Minister Lan Fo'an met with Congo Republic Deputy Prime Minister Bouya in Beijing. The two sides exchanged views on bilateral fiscal and financial cooperation and macroeconomic conditions. China Exim Bank Chairman Chen Huaiyu, Congo Minister of Finance, Budget and Public Treasury Jocka, and Ambassador to China Mamina attended. (Finance Ministry website)
